observations: The page number «10» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. L08 and L15: the chapter headings in bold, centred; in the left margin beside the heading of chapter 10 «O 101v», the folio of O at which the chapter begins.

L03: the commas after «fuerint» and «negligentur» stand 8 and 10 px from the words, where the commas of the page stand 1-4 px from the word; the line is set wide (word spaces 35-43 px); transcribed without a space. L06: «cifre», for cifrae, as printed.

N02: the i of «examínatione» carries an acute accent in the place of its dot, a sort of another fount; see the critical note. N19: the second figure of the note number 38 is printed broken, its lower loop open on the left, so that it looks like a 5 or a 9; read 38 by the order of the notes. N07: «ponit O —», without a point after the siglum before the dash. N07: «Addid. O in marg.» in italics, the O italic too; the colon after it stands after the thin space of the edition (10 px measured).
Marks not transcribed: a speck before the note number 43 (N22) and one after the bracket of note 38 (N19).

critical_notes.evidence: the i of the word is printed with an acute accent, í, a sort of another fount; the word is «examinatione», as «examinationi» in the next line
the readings of the manuscripts within a note are divided by commas; after the sigla CM a full stop is printed before the lower-case «argumentum», as on p. 9 (N14)
the lemma of the apparatus closes with a square bracket; after «elheca» of note 34 a round bracket is printed
